newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Ommeren sees 1997 net Dfl 100 mln. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Van Ommeren sees 1997 net Dfl 100 mln. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: Shipping and tank storage firm Koninklijke van Ommeren NV said on Thursday it expected to post full year 1997 profits of 100 million guilders, up from 94.4 million the previous year.
(Corrects to show figure is expected full year 1997 profits not actual Q1 profit).
"(Van Ommeren) announced that on the basis of performance in the first quarter, a net profit of at least NLG 100 million was expected for 1997 as a whole," Van Ommeren said in a statement.

Van Ommeren said its tank storage results were barely changed from from the first quarter of 1996. Tanker shipping results were firmer and the contribution of inland tanker shipping was also higher, mainly because of better results on gas shipping.
"The results of the transport services were on balance significantly better," the company said.
